fine_lines.title: loaf vs loaves
fine_lines.explanation_ar: loaf مفرد، وجمعه loaves: نغيّر f إلى v ونضيف es. آنا صححت نفسها: a loaf of bread... two loaves of bread. مثلها: knife → knives، leaf → leaves.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Loaf" is singular; the plural is "loaves" (f changes to v + es). Anna corrected herself: two loaves of bread. Also: knife → knives, leaf → leaves.

examples.sentence: I bought a loaf of bread.
We need two loaves for the party.

fine_lines.title: spend money vs spend time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: spend تأتي مع المال (ينفق) ومع الوقت (يقضي). آنا لم تنفق مالاً كثيراً لكنها قضت وقتاً طويلاً. نقول spend time + فعل ing: spend time shopping.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Spend" works with money and with time. Anna did not spend too much money, but she spent too much time. Use spend time + -ing verb: spend time shopping.

examples.sentence: Don't spend too much money on clothes.
I spend a lot of time reading.

fine_lines.title: bunch / box / bag / jar
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كل منها وعاء أو مجموعة مختلفة: bunch لمجموعة متصلة (موز، عنب، زهور)، box علبة كرتون، bag كيس، jar برطمان زجاجي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Each is a different container or group: a bunch (bananas, grapes, flowers), a box (cardboard), a bag (paper or plastic), a jar (glass with a lid).

grammar.title: Containers and quantities: a ___ of + noun
grammar.explanation_ar: مع الأسماء غير المعدودة (bread, coffee, peanut butter) أو مع مجموعات الأشياء، نستخدم وعاءً أو كمية لنعدّها: a bag of coffee، a jar of peanut butter، a loaf of bread، a box of pancake mix، a bunch of bananas. للجمع نجمع الوعاء وليس الطعام: two bags of coffee، two loaves of bread.
grammar.explanation_en: To count uncountable foods (bread, coffee, peanut butter) or groups of things, use a container or amount: a bag of coffee, a jar of peanut butter, a loaf of bread, a box of pancake mix, a bunch of bananas. For plurals, make the container plural: two bags of coffee, two loaves of bread.

grammar.title: Count and noncount nouns
grammar.explanation_ar: الاسم المعدود له مفرد وجمع: a banana, two bananas. الاسم غير المعدود ليس له جمع ولا نستخدم معه a/an: coffee, bread, flour, money, time. نقول too much مع غير المعدود: too much money, too much time، و too many مع المعدود: too many bananas.
grammar.explanation_en: Count nouns have singular and plural: a banana, two bananas. Noncount nouns have no plural and no a/an: coffee, bread, money, time. Use "too much" with noncount nouns (too much time) and "too many" with count nouns (too many bananas).
examples: I did not spend too much money.
But I did spend too much time!
There are too many bags in the car.

grammar.title: Promises and requests with will
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يطلب منك شخص شيئاً تستطيع أن تعد بـ Yes, I will أو ترفض بـ No, I won't. وفي الجملة المنفية التي تطلب منك ألا تفعل شيئاً (Do not spend too much time) نجيب بـ No, I won't بمعنى «لن أفعل».
grammar.explanation_en: When someone asks you to do something, promise with "Yes, I will." When they ask you NOT to do something (Do not spend too much time), agree with "No, I won't."
examples: "Please buy everything on the list." "Yes, I will."
